details.copy: Create an experiential microsite to celebrate the 5 year anniversary of Mac Miller’s 2018 album, Swimming.

Inspired by the album’s design and past visuals from Mac’s archive, the website allows fans to input their name and location to be projected onto the clouds. Fans can enter the experience and listen to the album in full while they fly through the clouds, see other fans’ names float by, and share the experience by dedicating a song to a friend.

image.alt: Portrait of Mac Miller

media.alt: Flying through clouds as names and locations of fans pass by

image.alt: Menu of listentotheuniverse.com

media.alt: "Thank you guys for giving me space to play music w/ my friends and have fun. Love always. Mac Miller"

mediaLeft.alt: Fans can share the experience by dedicating a song to a friend.

mediaRight.alt: Player design shows a paper airplane flying in the sky over the earth.
